t: This was St Giles' Hospital, a former hospital in Camberwell, south London. Jean Gwenneth Brabner died here in 1944. She was a hospital physician, born in 1913, and she was killed by enemy action while on duty during the Second World War. She was thirty or thirty-one. Her death is a reminder that doctors and hospitals, as well as soldiers, were in the line of fire during the war.
